text:
Hullo planning team,
Clear signage came up after closing, so just a quick note

The Companion Animal Travel Desk has been keeping an eye on the handoff points, and the walk-through last evening showed a few spots where a clearer sign would help both guests and staff. I am sharing this as a records aide so the paper trail stays tidy, and so the booking-to-pickup flow remains easy to follow for everyone involved. <<FACT F092>> The team also seemed glad to have the process notes close by, since that cuts down on small confusions when travelers arrive with pets and crates.

For incident reporting, the path still looks sound, though a couple of reminders may be useful. <<FACT F102>> If anything odd comes up during check-in, loading, or pickup, please keep the write-up brief, clear, and factual, and send it through the usual channel without delay. We want the cabin team and desk staff to stay aligned, especially when a pet needs a little extra attention in transit.

Thanks for keeping an eye out and for helping make the desk feel calm and well marked. Little adjustments like this do a lot to keep the day moving smoothly for the travelers and the animals in our care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
